Two vertex-disjoint cliques of size 4 would cover 2 × 4 = 8 vertices. But we need to cover 10 vertices. Since the cliques are vertex-disjoint (no shared vertices), we can only cover 8 vertices with 2 cliques of size 4.

The problem states "Every vertex must belong to one of these cliques" - this means all 10 vertices must be covered. But 2 cliques of size 4 can only cover 8 vertices.

This is mathematically impossible, so the answer is UNSATISFIABLE.
